title: Synthetic twist geometry in mesoscopic quantum circuits: geometric capacitance and chiral mode splitting
summary: We propose a route for encoding a helicoidally twisted synthetic geometry in mesoscopic quantum circuits. A torsionless spatial metric with twist parameter $\Om$ defines an electrostatic capacitance kernel whose angular--axial sector contains the chiral coupling $-2\Om mk$. We show that this kernel can be implemented by a finite, quantizable circuit graph built only from positive two-node capacitors: diagonal bridges generate the cross term, and the dimensionless twist is the ratio of diagonal to total angular capacitance.
